capability: Allows an application to have read-write access to files that the user has explicitly selected through standard macOS Open or Save dialogs.
reasoning: The entitlement name 'com.apple.security.files.user-selected.read-write' clearly indicates file operations ('files'), specifically on items chosen by the user ('user-selected'), with both read and write permissions ('read-write'). The provided description in the context explicitly confirms this capability: 'A Boolean value that indicates whether the app may have read-write access to files the user has selected using an Open or Save dialog.'
